### AI-Assisted Production Disclosure

This book was produced with the assistance of AI tools including Claude (Anthropic) for research aggregation, draft generation, and editorial workflows. All factual claims have been verified against primary sources. The 229 citations reference official papers, company announcements, government filings, and Tier-1 journalism. No AI-generated images are used; all charts and visualizations were generated from verified datasets using Python (matplotlib/seaborn).

The author maintains full editorial responsibility for all content, claims, and conclusions presented in this work.
